name: Ahmed Hassan
bio: Self-taught. Six months of focused React and Next.js in production — and still going deeper. I write code the way architects draw plans: structure first, then detail, then surface.

contributions.label: Design to Production
contributions.detail: Turned complex Figma UI components into clean, semantic React and Next.js code, maintaining precise responsiveness and visual specs across all screen sizes.

contributions.label: API & Form Architecture
contributions.detail: Handled frontend state management, integrated RESTful APIs, and built robust client-side validation layers to ensure stable data flow and reduce runtime bugs.

contributions.label: E-Commerce Deployment
contributions.detail: Collaborated on launching two e-commerce platforms, contributing to both the multi-tenant customer storefront and the internal merchant management dashboard.
